title_as_printed: Some Remarks on a Short Vocabulary of the Natives of Van Diemen Land; and also of the Menero Downs in Australia
author: John Lhotsky
journal: Journal of the Royal Geographical Society of London
heading_as_printed: E. and W. imply respectively the East and West side of Van Diemen Land.
place: Menero Downs, about 290 miles S.S.W. of Sydney (New South Wales); Hobart Town, Van Diemen Land
heard: Menero Downs 1834; Hobart Town 1836 (columns dated 1835); Van Diemen Land 1803 column from Peron list obtained by Robert Brown at Sydney 1803; Adelaide words obtained 1838
collector: John Lhotsky (Menero Downs; Van Diemen Land via Mr. M'Geary); 1803 list via Robert Brown; Adelaide words by G. Windsor Earl
about: Lhotsky took the Menero Downs words in 1834 from young people at the foot of the Australian Alps and the Van Diemen Land words at Hobart Town in 1836 from Mr. M'Geary, a resident of over twenty years; the Society's editors added an 1803 Van Diemen Land list bearing Peron's name and a few Adelaide words from G. Windsor Earl.
